title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2011 英语一 Part B 段落排序 · 本篇问题 2 题 + 历史弱项 6 题 · 全部使用迁移语境
footer: 本篇复盘结果只有在你点击“提交结果到 GitHub”并在 GitHub 再点 Submit new issue 后，才会进入后续间隔复习。

questions.q:
某候选段开头是：The key to reforming the system, concludes Professor Wang, is to change how new researchers are trained. 段末又说：Exactly how this can be achieved, however, remains unclear.
在一篇先分析问题、后给方案的文章中，这一段最可能放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次引出Professor Wang
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 这段说“王教授总结认为，改革这一体系的关键是改变新研究者的培养方式”，最后又以“具体如何实现仍不清楚”收束。它最可能位于全文结尾附近。
exp.structure: The key to reforming... is... 是总结性判断；concludes Professor Wang明确标记“作者/人物得出结论”；末句remains unclear留下开放尾声。这些都是收束段常见信号。
exp.other: reform 改革；conclude 总结认为；achieve 实现；remain unclear 仍不明确。
exp.meaning: 排序题中concludes、the key to...、yet exactly how... remains unclear等信号通常帮助识别尾段，不需要先翻懂所有细节。
exp.rest: 开头通常先介绍人物和问题，不会直接用concludes；放在问题分析之前会出现结论先于论证；“只能放在数据段之前”没有篇章依据。

questions.target: post=职位 / 不用常识补因果
questions.q: Marco said he was looking for an editor-in-chief post because he wanted final responsibility for a magazine's content. Which explanation stays closest to the text?
o: He mainly wanted better financial status.
He wanted a different level of professional responsibility.
He had been dismissed from his current job.
He was trying to avoid all management work.

exp.trans: Marco说他正在寻找总编辑职位，因为他想对一本杂志的内容承担最终责任。最贴近原文的是：他想获得不同层级的职业责任。
exp.structure: 主句：Marco + said + 宾语从句。宾语从句中he was looking for an editor-in-chief post；because从句he wanted final responsibility...解释求职动机。
exp.other: editor-in-chief 总编辑；final responsibility 最终责任；content 内容；professional responsibility 职业职责。
exp.meaning: 原文证据链是post → responsibility，而不是post → money。做阅读题必须沿文本明说的因果走。
exp.rest: financial status没有文本证据；dismissed没有被解雇信息；avoid management与想承担最终责任正相反。

questions.target: this separation / 唯一先行信息
questions.q:
前一段：The college teaches liberal arts in one school and professional training in another, insisting that the two should remain separate.
哪一句最可能作为下一段的开头？
o: This separation has also shaped the way teachers are trained.
These teachers were born in several different countries.
Such salaries are difficult to compare across cities.
That book was translated into three languages.

exp.trans: 前文说学院坚持把博雅教育和职业训练分开。最自然的下一段开头是：这种分离也塑造了教师培养的方式。
exp.structure: 前段已经明确提出the two should remain separate。下一段This separation中的this + 名词把上一句的“分离”整体名词化并回指，是一条非常硬的衔接。
exp.other: liberal arts 博雅教育；professional training 职业训练；remain separate 保持分开；shape 塑造。
exp.meaning: this + 抽象名词常把前文一个动作或关系重新命名。排序时必须找到前面唯一能对应的内容。
exp.rest: These teachers需要前文先出现teachers；Such salaries需要先出现salary；That book需要先出现某本书，三者在给定前文中都没有先行对象。

questions.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
questions.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: The healthier seedlings caused the gardeners to provide shade.
Shade provided by the gardeners reduced the seedlings' exposure to heat.
The seedlings protected the gardeners from the heat.
The heat was reduced because the seedlings dried out.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: healthier seedlings caused...把结果当成原先行动的原因；seedlings protected gardeners交换了保护者与被保护者；heat was reduced because...反转因果，还把减少高温暴露偷换成降低环境温度。

questions.q: The committee spent twenty minutes arguing about the font on the warning sign, while the real issue was whether the bridge was safe. They were clearly ___.
o: missing the point
making a point
reaching the point
pointing out

diag.1: make a point 常表示“提出观点/特意强调”，这里强调的是没抓住真正问题。
diag.2: reach the point 需要具体语境，如 reach the point where...，不能表达“没抓住重点”。
diag.3: point out 通常后接宾语，表示“指出”；这里既不合结构也不合语义。

exp.trans: 委员会花了二十分钟争论警示牌的字体，而真正的问题是这座桥是否安全。他们显然没有抓住重点。
exp.structure: 第一句：The committee（主语）+ spent（谓语）+ twenty minutes（宾语）；arguing...说明时间花在何事上。while连接对比；whether the bridge was safe作表语从句。第二句：They（主语）+ were missing（现在进行时谓语）+ the point（宾语）。
exp.other: committee 委员会；warning sign 警示牌；issue 问题/争议点；safe 安全的。
exp.meaning: miss the point = 没抓住重点、没理解关键。point 在这里是“要点/关键”，不是“节点”。
exp.rest: make a point = 提出/强调观点；reach the point = 达到某个阶段/程度；point out = 指出某事。只有 missing the point（没抓住重点）符合他们纠结字体却忽视桥梁安全的语境。

questions.skill: 被灌输信息 ≠ 被直接批评
questions.q: At a school, the wall of honour lists only perfect test scores. A pupil who has improved greatly still asks, “Does my progress count if I never appear on that wall?” Which inference is best supported?
o: The pupil has been personally insulted by every teacher.
The display may lead the pupil to doubt the value of improvement without perfection.
The school has failed to display any test scores.
Every pupil with a perfect score has made greater progress.

exp.trans: 一所学校的荣誉墙只列满分成绩。一名进步很大的学生仍问：“如果我从未登上那面墙，我的进步还算数吗？”最稳妥的推断是：这种展示可能让他怀疑没有满分的进步是否有价值。
exp.structure: 第一句：the wall of honour + lists + only perfect test scores。第二句：A pupil + asks + 引语；who has improved greatly修饰pupil。引语里if从句给出没有上榜这一条件。学生的问题体现了对进步价值的怀疑。
exp.other: wall of honour 荣誉墙；perfect score 满分；progress 进步；count 有价值/算数。
exp.meaning: 社会信息可以通过展示与选择标准传递，并影响自我评价；不需要出现直接人身批评。
exp.rest: personally insulted无直接侮辱证据，every teacher还扩大范围；failed to display any scores与列出满分矛盾；greater progress把最终成绩偷换成进步幅度。

questions.skill: with + 名词 + 后置成分
questions.q:
The bakery opened at six, with warm bread cooling on the counter.
with 后面的结构主要起什么作用？
o: 补充开门时伴随的状态
引出老板的直接引语
说明开门的唯一目的
充当opened的直接宾语

exp.trans: 面包店六点开门，当时温热的面包正在柜台上晾凉。
exp.structure: 主干：The bakery（主语）+ opened（不及物谓语）+ at six（时间状语）。原始简单句Warm bread was cooling on the counter → 去掉was，用with引出：with warm bread cooling on the counter。warm bread是with结构的逻辑主语，cooling是与之构成主动关系的现在分词。
exp.other: bakery 面包店；cool 晾凉、变凉；counter 柜台；warm 温热的。
exp.meaning: with复合结构可以补充主句发生时的伴随状态；它不是新的独立主句。
exp.rest: 直接引语通常由say等动词引出，此处没有任何说话行为。目的常用to do或in order to，原句只描写伴随状态。opened在本句是不及物用法，with短语不是其直接宾语。

questions.q: A rival laboratory offered unusually generous contracts in an attempt to ___ two senior researchers from our team.
o: attend to
poach
guard against
approve of

exp.trans: 一家竞争实验室开出异常优厚的合同，试图从我们团队挖走两名资深研究员。
exp.structure: 主干：A rival laboratory（主语）+ offered（谓语）+ contracts（宾语）。in an attempt to poach...表示目的；poach的宾语是two senior researchers，from our team说明从哪里挖走。
exp.other: rival competitor 竞争对手；generous contract 优厚合同；senior researcher 资深研究员；in an attempt to 试图。
exp.meaning: 商业/招聘语境中poach sb from... = 从别的组织挖人、挖角。
exp.rest: attend to = 处理/照料；guard against = 防范；approve of = 赞成。它们都不表达“用条件把别人的人才招走”。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, only a small share of those who remain receive an offer.
By contrast, the building was completed twenty years earlier.
For example, the company sells products in four countries.
In conclusion, this proves that all interviews are unnecessary.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: By contrast需要真正对立关系；For example需要前文有待举例的一般命题；In conclusion过早收束，而且all interviews are unnecessary也超出前文。

career-evidence.target: post=职位 / aspiration / 文本证据
career-evidence.skill: 熟词生义 + 证据约束
career-evidence.q: After five years as a sous-chef, Lena began applying for head-chef posts because she wanted to run a kitchen of her own. What is directly supported by the sentence?
o: She expected a higher salary.
She was pursuing a new career goal.
She disliked everyone in her current kitchen.
She had already been offered a head-chef job.

exp.trans: 做了五年副厨师长后，Lena开始申请主厨职位，因为她想独立管理一个厨房。句子直接支持：她正在追求新的职业目标。
exp.structure: 主句：Lena（主语）+ began applying（谓语）+ for head-chef posts。because从句给出原因：she wanted to run a kitchen of her own。原因明确指向职业角色和职责，而非薪酬。
exp.other: sous-chef 副厨师长；head-chef post 主厨职位；apply for 申请；run a kitchen 管理厨房。
exp.meaning: post在这里是职位；“想独立管理厨房”是职业抱负/目标。不能因为职位更高就擅自补出“工资更高”。
exp.rest: higher salary在现实中可能成立，但原句没有salary/pay等证据；disliked everyone完全无依据；began applying只表示开始申请，不等于已经拿到offer。

paragraph-order-anaphora.q:
前一段结尾：Several departments agree that first-year students need a common research course, but they cannot agree on what the course should include.
下面哪一段最适合紧接其后？
o: One reason such a course is hard to design is that each department defines research differently.
Professor Li published her first article in 2008 and later moved abroad.
Meanwhile, graduate salaries have risen in several unrelated industries.
The university library was renovated before the new president arrived.

exp.trans: 前文说多个院系同意开设共同研究课程，却无法就课程内容达成一致。最自然的下一段是：这种课程之所以难设计，一个原因是各院系对“研究”的定义不同。
exp.structure: 前段核心名词是a common research course / the course。正确后段以such a course回指这个已经出现的课程，再用One reason解释前文的困难。这里such不是凭空引入新对象。
exp.other: department 院系；first-year student 大一学生；define 定义；include 包含。
exp.meaning: 排序题看到such + 名词，要优先寻找前文已经出现并可被概括成该名词的先行对象。回指成立时通常是强接缝。
exp.rest: Professor Li引入新人物，没有承接course；graduate salaries换话题；library renovation也没有任何回指或因果连接。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

point.q:
Even after I explained the joke twice, my brother still missed the point.
missed the point 在这里表示什么？
o: 仍然怀念以前的笑话
仍然没明白笑话的关键
忘记了一个标点符号
没赶上兄弟聚会

exp.trans: 即使我把这个笑话解释了两遍，我弟弟仍然没有明白其中的关键。
exp.structure: 主句：my brother（主语）+ missed（谓语）+ the point（宾语）。after从句：I + explained + the joke；twice修饰explained。even强调即便已经解释过，结果仍如此。
exp.other: joke 笑话；twice 两次；still 仍然；explain 解释。
exp.meaning: miss the point整体表示没领会关键、没明白意思，不能把miss机械地译成怀念。
exp.rest: miss sb可表示想念某人，但miss the point不是这一义项。标点符号一般是punctuation mark，不是这里的point。miss a meeting可表示错过聚会，但原句没有meeting；brother是主语，不是被错过的活动。

point.target: point / there is no point in doing
point.q:
With the last bus already gone, there was no point in waiting at the stop.
point 在这里最接近：
o: 联合会
尖端
分数
意义、用处

exp.trans: 末班车已经开走了，继续在车站等也没有意义。
exp.structure: 主干：there was no point in waiting at the stop，是there be存在句。With the last bus already gone补充原因背景。简单句The last bus was already gone → 去掉was，用with + 名词 + 状态补语压缩。
exp.other: last bus 末班车；already 已经；be gone 已经离开、不在了；bus stop 公交站。
exp.meaning: there is no point in doing sth：做某事没有意义；point不是物理位置上的点。
exp.rest: 联合会常用federation/association，与句意无关。尖端可用the point of a needle，必须是具体物体的尖端。分数可说score three points，但这里不是计分语境。

social-message-inference.target: 社会暗示 / 满意度推断
social-message-inference.skill: 社会信息 ≠ 直接批评
social-message-inference.q: A workplace culture repeatedly celebrates employees who stay late, and workers who leave on time are often reminded that “real commitment means sacrifice.” What is most safely suggested?
o: Workers who leave on time are formally punished every day.
The culture may make some workers question whether they are committed enough.
Employees who stay late are always more productive.
Managers ignore workers who leave on time.

exp.trans: 一种职场文化反复赞美加班员工，而准时下班的人经常被提醒“真正的投入意味着牺牲”。最稳妥的推断是：这种文化可能让一些人怀疑自己是否足够投入。
exp.structure: 主句1：A workplace culture + celebrates + employees。who stay late修饰employees。主句2：workers who leave on time + are reminded + that从句。that从句给出被灌输的信息。题目要从这种持续信息推断心理影响，而不是擅自添加处罚事实。
exp.other: workplace culture 职场文化；commitment 投入/忠诚；sacrifice 牺牲；question whether 怀疑是否。
exp.meaning: 反复接收到某种价值信息，最直接支持的是“可能影响自我判断/满意度”，不等于已经遭受正式批评或惩罚。
exp.rest: formally punished every day加入原文没有的正式处罚；always more productive把价值宣传偷换成生产率事实；ignore与“are often reminded”相反。

with.target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
with.skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
with.q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: adds a simultaneous background state
states the purpose of waiting
introduces an independent main clause
means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

recruitment-vocab.q: The museum hired a specialist recruiter to ___ candidates with experience in restoring ancient textiles. Which phrase best fits?
o: hunt for
attend to
guard against
approve of

exp.trans: 博物馆聘请了一名专业招聘人员，去物色有古代纺织品修复经验的候选人。
exp.structure: 主干：The museum + hired + a specialist recruiter。to hunt for candidates是不定式作目的状语；with experience...修饰candidates。
exp.other: specialist recruiter 专业招聘人员；candidate 候选人；restore 修复；ancient textiles 古代纺织品。
exp.meaning: hunt for = 寻找、搜寻、物色。它强调寻找对象；poach则进一步强调从别处把人挖走。
exp.rest: attend to = 处理/照料，常见attend to a customer/problem；guard against = 防范；approve of = 赞成。均不表示招聘人员寻找候选人。

article_session.source: 2011 英语一 Part B 段落排序
